groups.defect: Synchronous tagging makes anonymous authentication wait on database operations and ties tagging to request cancellation; authentication also introduces limit refusals without corresponding caller error handling.
groups.rationale: Both report the same blocking regression caused by replacing background tagging with a synchronous call. Their additional concerns about request cancellation and handling the new authentication refusal must survive consolidation.

groups.defect: The non-atomic device count and subsequent insert allow concurrent requests to exceed the configured limit.
groups.rationale: Both identify the same check-then-insert race in CreateOrUpdateDevice and request atomic enforcement.

groups.defect: Caching a device before its database write succeeds lets a rejected device bypass limit enforcement on retry.
groups.rationale: Both identify the same premature cache insertion and propose caching only successful writes or removing entries on failure.
